Prism Specialization
If an opponent declares an attack, they must choose this as the target of that attack if able.
Spectra

text.markup:
**Prism Specialization** _(You may only have this in your deck if your hero is Prism.)_
Opponents may only select Arc Light Sentinel as the target of an attack.
**Spectra** _(This can be attacked. When this becomes the target of an attack, destroy it and close the combat chain. The attack does not resolve.)_

text.markup:
**Prism Specialization** _(You may only have Arc Light Sentinel in your deck if your hero is Prism.)_
If Arc Light Sentinel is in the arena when an opponent announces an attack, they must choose Arc Light Sentinel as the target of the attack.
**Spectra** _(Arc Light Sentinel can be attacked. When Arc Light Sentinel becomes the target of an attack, destroy it and close the combat chain. The attack does not resolve.)_
